character_descriptions.Alex: Confident and adventurous, Alex has a charming smile and bright blue eyes. He stands tall with a lean build.
character_descriptions.Sarah: Shy and introverted, Sarah has a petite frame and soft features. She sits quietly with her hair styled in loose waves.

scene_segments.speaker: Alex
scene_segments.dialogue: I'm Alex, 28, from New York City.
scene_segments.scene_description: Close-up of Alex's face as he speaks, with a slight smile on his lips. The camera pans out to reveal him standing confidently in front of the villa group.

scene_segments.speaker: Jamie
scene_segments.dialogue: Wow, it looks like we've got a pretty diverse group here.
scene_segments.scene_description: Over-shoulder shot of Jamie as he speaks, looking around the room with amusement. The camera pans to reveal the group's varying ages and ethnicities.

scene_segments.speaker: Sarah
scene_segments.scene_description: Medium shot of Sarah as she speaks, her eyes sparkling with interest. The camera pans across the room to reveal the others' reactions.

scene_segments.speaker: Jamie (Reaction)
scene_segments.scene_description: Close-up of Jamie's face as he responds to Sarah, his eyes locking onto hers for a brief moment.
